description: This Java source file defines the StatusFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for managing and displaying the UI related to the status of a specific app (enabling, hiding, or reinstalling). It includes methods for lifecycle management, UI updates, and interacting with DevicePolicyManager to hide/unhide the app.

classes.name: StatusFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment managing UI and functionality for app restriction status, such as hiding or unhiding an app based on device policy.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components after view creation.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to the activity and initializes the listener.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the UI when the fragment becomes active.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for UI buttons.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Checks the app's installation and visibility status and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: unhideApp
methods.description: Unhides the app in the device policy management.
